notes: This is the cover and attendance page of the sitting: masthead, presiding officer, secretaries and prosecretaries, then the two-column roll of senators present and the short list of those absent with notice. Nobody speaks on it, so utterance_starts is empty and anything the parser attributes to a speaker here is a false positive. Judgement call: I treated the centred masthead, the presiding line and the officers block as furniture rather than headings, because they are the cover's standing matter and not section titles of the debate; the only two things printed in the manner of a heading (bold, standing alone above a block) are 'PRESENTES:' and 'AUSENTES, CON AVISO:', so those are in headings. A maintainer who prefers the masthead counted as headings can move them. Typographically strange: two secretary names are printed with the spaces missing — 'JuanHéctorEstrada' for Juan Héctor Estrada, and 'señor D.José Lepere' with no space after 'D.'. The motto on this sitting is set with straight double quotes and a missing space ('"2014 -Año'), unlike the curly quotes used in 2013 and 2015.
